输入脚本，实时预览卡片。头号悬赏；若赛前已有 MVP，则转为体验增强。: Write scripts and preview cards live. A priority bounty; if an MVP exists before the event, focus on improving the experience.
把 L0 校验带进命令行与编辑器，让创作反馈更及时。: Bring L0 validation into the command line and editor for faster feedback.
错误码与修复建议，帮助模型理解失败并完成自修复。: Provide error codes and actionable suggestions so models can understand failures and repair their output.
从子串匹配走向 OR、禁止与计数规则，提升卡片质量校验。: Move beyond substring matching to OR, prohibition and counting rules for better card validation.
为 Octoscript 与 OctoSense 的接口一致性提供自动检查。: Automatically check interface consistency between Octoscript and OctoSense.
测试解析器边界，提高面对复杂输入时的稳定性。: Test parser boundaries and improve resilience to complex input.
把语言行为写成清晰规范，技术写作者也可认领。: Document language behavior in a clear specification. Technical writers are welcome to take this on.
用 TypeScript 或 Python，把 Octos 接到手机之外的界面。: Connect Octos to interfaces beyond the phone using TypeScript or Python.
完善 schema 导出、类型生成或协议一致性测试。: Improve schema export, type generation or protocol conformance tests.
简化 manifest 与注册流程，让新能力更容易起步。: Simplify manifests and registration to make new capabilities easier to build.
读取自身运行指标，发现卡片失败，自动修复并重新发布。: Read runtime metrics, detect card failures, then repair and republish automatically.
公布阶梯、双评奖线、悬赏榜与分值，收集技能标签，启动组队撮合。: Publish the steps, two award categories, bounties and scores; collect skills and begin team matching.
理解主题，看「一句话 → 活卡片」真机演示，了解赛制，参加组队集市。: Explore the theme, watch a sentence become a live card on a device, learn the rules and meet potential teammates.
学习声明、no-facts 与事件，使用能力菜单，写一张卡并通过 validat: Learn declarations, no-facts and events. Use the capability menu, write a card that passes validation and submit an app.md draft.
从预打包环境跑到真机，添加最小数据源，学习组件注册与跨后端契约。: Run the packaged environment on a device, add a minimal data source and learn component registration and cross-backend contracts.
理解 Octoscript 工具链与 Octos 协议，逐题了解切入点、交付物和: Explore the Octoscript toolchain and Octos protocol, with entry points, deliverables and acceptance criteria for each bounty.
Mentor、平台技术台与环境急救台值守；中途进行 checkpoint dem: Mentors, platform support and environment troubleshooting are available. Share a checkpoint demo, then present your finished work.
贡献合入 · 采纳奖 · 作品归档: Merge contributions · Adoption awards · Archive projects
Mentor 协助完善 PR；合并窗口结束，按实际采纳结果补发奖励，作品进入 e: Mentors help refine PRs. At the end of the merge window, adoption awards recognize accepted contributions, with projects added to examples and the app library.
不会 Rust，也能独立参赛吗？: Can I enter on my own without knowing Rust?
可以。STEP 1 是零编译路径，用既有能力写需求式 spec、lint 规则和: Yes. STEP 1 requires no compilation: use existing capabilities to write a requirements-based spec, lint rules and reference cards. Intent Design and Technical Breakthrough carry equal prize money, and a pure L0 project can win the Grand Prize.
必须组队吗？没有技术伙伴怎么办？: Do I need a team or a technical teammate?
不强制组队，也不要求每队必须有技术成员。赛前组队集市提供撮合，赛中平台技术台可提: Neither teams nor technical teammates are required. Pre-event team matching helps you find collaborators, and the platform desk can offer limited help connecting capabilities. This is event support, not outsourced project work.
没有 Android 手机怎么办？: What if I do not have an Android phone?
蓝图安排测试机供现场演示，并提供桌面路径作为兜底。设备借用方式与环境包将在赛前说: The blueprint provides for test devices for live demos and a desktop fallback. Device borrowing details and environment packages will be announced before the event.
模型只写布局与数据绑定，不编造天气、价格等事实。真实数据在渲染时由 sys.*: The model writes layouts and data bindings, without inventing facts such as weather or prices. Real data is fetched by sys.* helpers at render time. Cards must follow the capability menu and L0 validation rules.
做工具链或内核，就不用做应用了吗？: Can I work on the toolchain or kernel instead of an app?
仍需回到统一命题：一句话变成能用的应用。技术突破必须服务自己的作品演示；悬赏贡献: Every entry must address the same challenge: turn a sentence into a working app. Technical advances must support your project demo. Bounty contributions earn separate contribution points and do not replace the demo.
报名什么时候开放？奖金是多少？: When does registration open, and what are the prizes?

单一命题 · 三级阶梯 · 双线评奖: One challenge · Three steps · Two award categories
用一句话，生成一个能用的应用。: Turn a single sentence into an app that works.
面向设计师、产品人、OPC（一人公司）、学生，以及懂 Rust 的开发者。围绕: For designers, product builders, solo founders, students and Rust developers. Start with a real intent and use OctoSense to build an app you can demonstrate.
可以独立参赛，也可以自由组队。赛前组队集市帮助你找到伙伴，赛中平台技术台提供能力: Enter solo or form a team. Find collaborators through pre-event team matching, and get help connecting capabilities at the platform support desk.
跑通的演示 + 进入仓库的 spec / 代码: A working demo + a spec or code contributed to the repository
真机优先，桌面演示兜底。无论深入哪一层，最终都要回到「一句话 → 活的 App」: Prioritize a real-device demo, with desktop as a fallback. At every level, the goal remains the same: one sentence becomes a live app.
一个命题，三级深度: One challenge. Three levels of depth.
阶梯是加分维度，不是资格线。把 STEP 1 做到极致，同样可以夺冠。: The steps offer ways to earn points, not entry requirements. An outstanding STEP 1 project can win the Grand Prize.
写一份需求式 app.md，配上 lint 规则与参考卡片。组合既有数据源和组件: Write a requirements-based app.md with lint rules and reference cards. Combine existing data sources and components into a travel planner, shopping list, fitness tracker or podcast digest.
看重意图设计、信息设计与泛化能力: Focus on intent, information design and generalization
为你的创意新增一个 sys.* helper：公共交通、汇率、日历或空气质量。完: Add a sys.* helper for your idea: transit, exchange rates, calendars or air quality. Define contracts, error handling and rate limits so the capability reliably serves your app.
交付 / 新数据能力 + 应用演示: Deliver / a new data capability + app demo
扩展所有参赛者都能使用的能力菜单: Expand the capability menu for everyone
创建可视化组件，打通 L0 交互态，或认领悬赏榜中的工具链与协议题目。每一次平台: Build visual components, enable L0 interaction states or take on toolchain and protocol bounties. Every platform advance should improve your project experience.
交付 / 平台贡献 + 应用演示: Deliver / a platform contribution + app demo
技术突破必须服务于自己的作品: Technical advances must support your own project

评选数据能力契约质量，以及组件、工具链、协议作品的深度与可合并性。: Recognizes data capability contract quality, and the depth and merge readiness of components, toolchains and protocol work.
赛后两周合并窗口结束时，按实际合入仓库的 PR、应用与规范补发。: Awarded after the two-week post-event merge window, based on PRs, apps and specifications actually accepted into the repositories.
STEP 1 的极致设计同样可以拿满创意与完成度分。技术深度加分，不设技术资格门: An exceptional STEP 1 design can earn full creativity and completion points. Technical depth adds value, but is not an eligibility requirement.
可合并 PR、入库应用与能力、合格缺口 issue、采纳规范；客观清单及分值赛前: Merge-ready PRs, accepted apps and capabilities, qualifying gap reports and adopted specifications. The checklist and point values will be published before the event.
意图到应用的想象力、实际跑通程度，以及服务作品的能力与平台突破。: The imagination behind intent-to-app, how well it works, and the capability or platform advances that support it.
3 分钟真机 demo + 2 分钟讲清「我的作品让项目多了什么」。: A 3-minute device demo, followed by 2 minutes explaining what your work adds to the project.
让下一个人接得住的 README / spec。混合组队、使用他队能力或工具，双: A README or spec that others can build on. Mixed teams and sharing capabilities or tools across teams earn points for both sides.
工具链与平台贡献: Build the tools. Extend the platform.
悬赏是 STEP 3 的选题，也可以是赛中的小贡献。以下为蓝图中的建议题目，难度: Bounties can be STEP 3 projects or smaller contributions during the event. These are proposed topics from the blueprint; difficulty, scores and claiming details will be announced before the event.
缺口，也是贡献。: Finding a gap is a contribution, too.
发现可复现的语言表达缺口、契约漂移、文档错误或误导性诊断？提交合格 issue: Found a reproducible language limitation, contract drift, documentation error or misleading diagnostic? Submit a qualifying issue to earn points. In addition to its creative project, each team must claim at least one bounty or issue, verified at the awards.

跨平台的 Agent 交互 Shell，运行在 Windows、macOS、Li: A cross-platform agent shell that runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS. It is both the familiar launcher for your apps and a proactive, intent-driven agent: every app is a touchpoint, backed by one shared memory and an understanding that keeps evolving.
由 Makepad 的 Splash 演化而来、面向 Agent 需求优化的动态: A dynamic DSL evolved from Makepad's Splash and tuned for agents. It interprets app logic and generates UI in real time with no compile step: JavaScript-like on the surface, Rust underneath. App Cards and theme kits are built with it.
可嵌入的 Rust 原生 Agent harness 内核。多轮交互、上下文与记: An embeddable, Rust-native agent harness kernel. Multi-turn interaction, context and memory, model providers, concurrent agents, tools, sandboxing and user approval are all exposed to apps through the OS UI protocol.
OctoSense 是运行在操作系统之上的 Agent 交互 Shell。它看起: OctoSense is an agent shell on top of your operating system. It looks like the launcher and the apps you already know, and it behaves like an agent that understands your intent, senses what is changing around you, and reshapes those apps before you ask.
今天的 Agent 界面都是聊天框：线性、单向、只有文本。OctoSense 走: Today's agent interfaces are chat windows: linear, one-way, text only. OctoSense takes the other road. It keeps the app interactions people already know and puts the agent inside the apps, instead of pulling people into a chat box.
新闻、天气、行情、出行仍是稳定的起点，入口之下的内容围绕你的意图生成。: News, weather, markets and travel stay stable places to start. Beneath each one, the content is generated around your intent.
由时间和事件驱动：降温、航班延误、日程变化，都会让应用重新组织、提前准备。: Driven by time and events: a cold front, a delayed flight or a schedule change makes the apps reorganize and prepare ahead.
把为十亿人打造的超级应用裁剪到你需要的部分，持续生成、持续进化。: Super apps built for a billion people are trimmed to what you need, generated and evolved continuously.
重要决定留给你。Agent 把一天提炼成几件需要确认的事，确认后一切随之更新。: The important decisions stay with you. The agent distills the day into a few things to confirm, and everything updates once you do.
风格、配色、字体随人和时刻变化。像章鱼一样，它在感知，也在变色。: Style, color and typography adapt to the person and the moment. Like an octopus, it senses and changes color.
你看到的每个应用都是触点。触点背后是同一个 Agent、同一份记忆，以及对你所处: Every app you see is a touchpoint. Behind them all is one agent, one memory, and an understanding of your world that keeps evolving.
